pitches.logline: Gio drove three friends to a night match at Dinamo Arena. After the final whistle they wait at the gate, but he cannot find where he left the car in the side streets.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: a phone lights up among the crowd's tail lights and his friend yells through the speaker; real-phone-buzz
pitches.heroObject: the parked car in the side streets

pitches.logline: Nika rents a car for a weekend in Batumi and parks it near the boulevard; that evening he remembers neither the street nor the car's colour.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: Nika pulls open the wrong silver sedan and its owner shouts at him; real-door

pitches.logline: Luka, the best man in Sighnaghi, left the rings in the glovebox and cannot find the car in the hilly lanes as the ceremony starts.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: the groom yells through Luka's phone speaker over a church bell; real-phone-buzz

treatment.logline: Gio (me) drove his friends to a night match at Dinamo Arena; after it he cannot find where he left the car in the side streets.
treatment.hero: me, Gio, the driver of the group, and his one car parked in the side streets by the stadium
treatment.heroObject: the parked car in the side streets
treatment.obstacle: every kerb round the stadium looks the same at night and he never noted the spot

hook.event: the match is over, the night street freezes as the phone buzzes and his friend yells at him through it, calling him a frog over the missing car

act1: the spot he is sure of has a stranger's car in it, horns blaring (horn-chorus)
the rain starts on the car roofs (real-rain-roof)
the friends give up and leave by taxi: the phone buzzes with their message
treatment.turn: the message lands and the beat holds in silence (hold 0.6) before the app

reveal.what: the parking row on the real home screen: the app remembers where you parked, with no internet

screens.step: the parking row on the home screen
tap the parking pin in the tab bar
the saved spot with its floor and row

treatment.payoff: next match, the same street: he calls the friends straight to the car, it is this way
treatment.signature: ScreenTour on 07-parking: the save row pressed, then the saved spot's floor and row; the round-3 part this film's facts fit

post.description: დინამო არენასთან მატჩის ღამეს გვერდით ქუჩებში ყველა კუთხე სავსეა და ერთნაირად გამოიყურება. შენ სად აჩერებ ხოლმე სტადიონთან?

ვინარი იმახსოვრებს, | სად გააჩერე მანქანა. | ინტერნეტი | არც კი სჭირდება.
